request-prompt: Replace the technical specifications overview with an interactive 'Help Me Choose' wizard that recommends a model based on simple daily tasks like studying, office work, or creative projects.
goal: I am a casual user who is overwhelmed by technical jargon; I prefer simplified, benefit-driven explanations of what a laptop can do for my daily routine.
jobs: I want to purchase a new Samsung Galaxy Book6 laptop.
I want to compare the specifications of the Galaxy Book6 Ultra and the Galaxy Book6 Pro to decide which model is right for me.
I want to learn about the new Galaxy AI features, battery life, and performance capabilities of the Galaxy Book6 series.
I want to customize the processor, RAM, storage, and color options of a Galaxy Book6 laptop to see the total price.
I want to check if there are any trade-in deals, discounts, or promotional offers available when buying this laptop.
I want to find out the delivery times, shipping costs, and return policies for the Galaxy Book6 series.

preference-pairs.a: I am a tech enthusiast who makes purchase decisions based on detailed hardware specifications, performance benchmarks, and in-depth component breakdowns.
preference-pairs.b: I am a casual user who is overwhelmed by technical jargon; I prefer simplified, benefit-driven explanations of what a laptop can do for my daily routine.

preference-pairs.a: I strongly prefer staying loyal to one brand ecosystem (like Samsung Galaxy) so all my devices connect and sync together effortlessly.
preference-pairs.b: I am brand-agnostic and always choose the absolute best standalone value for my budget, even if it means mixing different device ecosystems.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer purchasing expensive electronics directly from the official brand's website because I trust their official customer service and exclusive trade-in deals more.
preference-pairs.b: I rarely buy high-end electronics online without trying them out in a physical store first to feel the build quality, keyboard, and screen in person.

preference: I am a casual user who is overwhelmed by technical jargon; I prefer simplified, benefit-driven explanations of what a laptop can do for my daily routine.
